summary: AAP can manage nodes hardened to profiles such as CIS, PCI-DSS or DISA STIG, but some controls must be relaxed for AAP's own servers: apply the profile before installing, then adjust the listed controls and discuss waivers with your security auditor.
questions: Can I install AAP on STIG-hardened RHEL?
Do I need security waivers to run AAP under CIS?
